_why: The axes the model decision needs (docs/MODELS.md):
(xhigh=default/medium/low/none). NOT a full cross product - only the 7
cells that every question can be answered out of.
KV cache is f16 rather than q8_0 on purpose: q8+FlashAttention does not
load on ROCm (KyaniteLabs, negative result), and the variants have to
carry the SAME KV type or the sweep compares two things at once.
No --mmproj: the battery is text only and loading is faster without it.
Sampling: server default, identical in every variant.
@MODELS@ and @HOME@ are expanded by setup/lib/systemdfile.py, the same
reader the profiles and the unit use. Absolute paths stood here until
27.08. and tied the file to one computer - including to one CHECKOUT:
a second clone on the same machine could not run a sweep either.
The build directories are named as they were MEASURED, and not moved
on to the current ones. build-rocm here is the stock build of 24.08.,
not build-rocm-patched: repointing it would silently change what these
cells compared, which is the one thing a recorded variant may not do.
A new question gets a new variants file.

variants.name: vulkan-xhigh-nospec
variants.note: The baseline: what qwen38.env did at the time — Vulkan, no speculation, the template's default thinking level (xhigh).

variants.name: rocm-xhigh-nospec
variants.note: Isolates the backend effect alone, against vulkan-xhigh-nospec.

variants.name: rocm-xhigh-spec
variants.note: Isolates the speculation effect alone (MTP+ngram, the KyaniteLabs stack), against rocm-xhigh-nospec.

variants.name: rocm-medium-spec
variants.note: The candidate for the production default: medium rather than xhigh, which was an operator's choice and not a measurement.

variants.name: rocm-low-spec
variants.note: What the community recommends for coding agents — VS Code, Cursor and Claude Code all suggest low.

variants.name: rocm-nothink-spec
variants.note: Lower bound: no thinking at all. Measured 24.08.: the template knows ONLY reasoning_effort xhigh/medium/low - 'none' raises a Jinja exception. Switching it off goes through enable_thinking:false (KyaniteLabs does the same).

variants.name: rocm-medium-spec-q8kv
variants.note: The KV question for production: qwen38.env carries q8_0 and KyaniteLabs reports a q8+FA load failure on ROCm. Does it load here? And what does it cost against f16 (rocm-medium-spec)?

variants.name: vulkan-medium-spec
variants.note: Tests the KyaniteLabs claim that Vulkan halves speculative decode throughput. It held: 96.9 s against 51.7 s median, measured 24.08.
